row.notes: R&D upgrade-tree NODE loader (the tile data source): loops the same dept-code table (0x145735d60 codes 0..4, break at 5, NO code-4 exclusion), opens <team_link>.<deptname>.upgrade by instancecount (Gdb_Init_TableCursor), reads grid_coordinates.x/y + every column, appends all departments nodes (incl code-4 fake) into the combined tree model at UpgradesComponent+0x68+0x28. Called from the model builder 0x14353abb0 (player team r8b=0xff + per linked team). Sibling of the flat Career_Load_UpgradeRows 0x143539bc0. Node links resolve via Gdb_Find_RowByLabel (0x1445a2bd0, scan 0..instancecount-1) so our upgrade_1/2/3 need the instancecount bump to be in range.  engine-suppliers 2026-11-13 (capstone): key arg rdx +0x10 is the joined row path char* (checked non-empty at 0x14353b063); r8b engine stat id, 0xff for the team tree (0x14353abee), parent_engine stat id per engine_supplier_upgrades row (0x14353aff8, called 0x14353ae08). Builder loads EVERY supplier row into every team tree; hooked by native/src/core/guards/career/rnd_suppliers_guard.cpp.
